name: circuit-breaker-tuning-p4
prompt: how should I tune the failure threshold and cool-down so a flaky dependency does not keep getting hammered

chunks.content: decided to open the breaker once 50 percent of the last 20 calls to the dependency error out, rather than a fixed count, so a slow degradation trips it the same as a hard outage
after tripping we wait 30 seconds in open state before allowing a single trial request, doubling the wait each time the trial keeps failing so we stop pounding a service that is still down
the login form locks an account after 5 wrong password attempts and shows a cool-down timer before the user can try again
replaced the loading spinner with a skeleton placeholder on the dashboard cards
in the half-open probe we let exactly one request through and close the breaker only if it succeeds, otherwise we re-open and reset the back-off clock
bumped the postgres connection pool from 20 to 40 after seeing checkout latency spikes under load
the on-call alert threshold was tuned to fire when error rate stays above 50 percent for two minutes so we stop getting paged for brief blips
moved the password-reset email copy into the localized template bundle
while the breaker is open we serve a cached last-known-good response instead of letting the request pile up waiting on the dead dependency
export breaker state transitions and trip counts to Prometheus so we can graph how often each dependency degrades
thumbnails are generated at upload time in three sizes and stored alongside the original
a nightly job purges soft-deleted rows older than 30 days from the audit table
gated the new search ranking behind a flag defaulting to off
the /healthz probe returns 200 only after the cache warm-up finishes
